name: walkAcc_correct
prelude:
inductive Tree (α : Type u) where
  | empty : Tree α
  | node : Tree α → α → Tree α → Tree α
def inorder : Tree α → List α
  | .empty => []
  | .node l x r => inorder l ++ x :: inorder r
def walkAcc : Tree α → List α → List α
  | .empty, acc => acc
  | .node l x r, acc => walkAcc l (x :: walkAcc r acc)
statement: theorem walkAcc_correct (t : Tree α) (acc : List α) : walkAcc t acc = inorder t ++ acc
proofs:
induction t generalizing acc with
  | empty => rfl
  | node l x r il ir => simp [walkAcc, inorder, il, ir, List.append_assoc]
  have suffix (t : Tree α) (as bs : List α) : walkAcc t (as ++ bs) = walkAcc t as ++ bs := by
    induction t generalizing as with
    | empty => rfl
    | node l x r il ir => simp [walkAcc, ir, ← il]
  have empty_acc (t : Tree α) : walkAcc t [] = inorder t := by
    induction t with
    | empty => rfl
    | node l x r il ir =>
      have h := suffix l [] (x :: inorder r)
      simpa [walkAcc, inorder, il, ir] using h
  have h := suffix t [] acc
  simpa [empty_acc] using h
strategies: Tree induction generalized over the accumulator.
Prove suffix-equivariance and empty-accumulator correctness separately.
